data.short: 从句是挂车，自己不能上路
data.desc: Although it was raining. ——这半句挂在半空没说完：从属连词带的句子是挂车，必须挂上主句，如 Although it was raining, Ram went swimming.
data.formal: EnglishClub："A subordinate or dependent clause 'depends' on a main or independent clause. It cannot exist alone."；Cambridge：分句跟上这些连词后「becomes a subordinate clause, which needs a main clause to make a complete sentence」。
data.kid: 带从属连词的那半句是挂车：看着像句子，其实要主句拉着走，单独放出来，谁也听不懂它想说什么。

beats.name: 挂车长什么样
beats.text: 从属连词 + 主语 + 动词，零件齐全，却是个依附品：EnglishClub 的原话是它 depends on（依靠）主句，不能 exist alone（单独存在）。

beats.name: 半句话演示
beats.text: 有人只对你说一句 "Although it was raining." 就停下——你什么也没听懂，因为话只说了一半。补上主句，意思才落地：Although it was raining, Ram went swimming.

beats.name: AAAWWUBBIS 大巴口诀
beats.text: 常用从属连词编成一辆「大巴」：After, Although, As, When, While, Until, Before, Because, If, Since——读作 AAAH-Whoo-Bus，十个队员一次记齐（课堂材料口诀，研究合集第 5 章）。

beats.name: 逗号跟着位置走
beats.text: 挂车在前，挂车后面加逗号：Although it was raining, Ram went swimming.挂车在后，一般不加逗号：Ram went swimming although it was raining.（EnglishClub 结构图 / Purdue OWL）

examples.s: Although it was raining, Ram went swimming.
examples.note: EnglishClub 原例：挂车在前，加逗号

examples.s: Ram went swimming although it was raining.
examples.note: 挂车在后，不加逗号

examples.s: We left after the meeting ended.
examples.note: 时间挂车

examples.s: Call me when you arrive.
examples.note: when 挂车在后

examples.s: If you study, you will pass.
examples.note: 条件挂车在前，加逗号

examples.s: She was absent because she was ill.
examples.note: 原因挂车在后

examples.s: Wash your hands before you eat.
examples.note: before 挂车在后

errors.wrong: Because I was tired.
errors.right: I went to bed because I was tired.
errors.type: 句子残缺（fragment）
errors.diag: 挂车单独加句号，就是残缺句。Purdue OWL 对从属分句的定义就是 cannot stand alone。回补机制第 1、2 节。

errors.wrong: Although it was raining.
errors.right: Although it was raining, we went out.
errors.type: 句子残缺（fragment）
errors.diag: EnglishClub 的课堂演示就是这一句：单说它，听者什么也理解不了。回补机制第 2 节。

quiz.q: 哪句是完整的？A. When you arrive. B. Call me when you arrive.
quiz.ans: B——A 只是挂车，B 给它挂上了主句。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 1 节「挂车长什么样」。

quiz.q: AAAWWUBBIS 打头的三个 A 是哪三个词？
quiz.ans: After, Although, As。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 3 节的大巴口诀。

adult.t: 不能独立的规则与半句话演示引 EnglishClub《Subordinating Conjunctions》（verified live）；从属连词清单综合 Cambridge（verified live）与 Khan Academy 课程清单；九组语义分类综合 EnglishClub / Cambridge / Khan / 大学写作中心分类表（研究合集 1.4）；AAAWWUBBIS 出自课堂材料转引（index）。从属连词永远位于其分句之首，能移动的是整个分句（Cambridge）。

data.short: 时间队：先做哪件，后做哪件
data.desc: when、before、after、until、while 都是报时间的：两件事谁先谁后，它们排顺序——Wash your hands before you eat.
data.formal: 研究合集时间组（综合 EnglishClub / Cambridge / Khan 分类表）：after, as, as soon as, before, once, since, till, until, when, whenever, while；EnglishClub 常用表含 after, before, till, until, when, while。
data.kid: 这队连词一开口，先把两件事的先后顺序报清楚。

beats.name: 报先后
beats.text: 两件事摆在一起，时间连词负责排队：哪件先发生、哪件后发生，一听就明白。

beats.name: as soon as = 一……就……
beats.text: 前一件刚发生，后一件马上跟上，中间不留空档。

beats.name: until = 一直等到
beats.text: 动作一直持续，到某个时间点才停：Wait here until I come back.（等到我回来为止）

beats.name: while = 同时进行
beats.text: while 报的是「同一段时间里」：两件事同时在做。

examples.s: We left after the meeting ended.
examples.note: after：开完会之后（研究合集原例）

examples.s: Call me when you arrive.
examples.note: when：到了的时候（研究合集原例）

examples.s: Wash your hands before you eat.
examples.note: before：吃饭之前（研究合集原例）

examples.s: As soon as the bell rang, we ran out.
examples.note: as soon as：一响铃就跑出去

examples.s: Wait here until I come back.
examples.note: until：一直等到我回来

examples.s: While I was reading, Mum was cooking.
examples.note: while：我看书的同时妈妈做饭

examples.s: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.
examples.note: before：睡觉之前先刷牙

errors.wrong: After the meeting ended.
errors.right: We left after the meeting ended.
errors.type: 句子残缺（fragment）
errors.diag: after 带的还是挂车，单独成句就残缺。回补 NEW-CJ04 机制第 1 节。

errors.wrong: When you arrive call me.
errors.right: When you arrive, call me.
errors.type: 挂车在句首漏逗号
errors.diag: 从属分句放在句首时，后面要加逗号（Purdue OWL / EnglishClub）。回补 NEW-CJ04 机制第 4 节。

errors.wrong: As soon as, the bell rang, we ran out.
errors.right: As soon as the bell rang, we ran out.
errors.type: 逗号位置错误
errors.diag: 从属连词永远站在自己分句的最前面，逗号要等整个分句说完再放。回补 NEW-CJ04 机制第 4 节。

quiz.q: 选词填空：___ you eat, wash your hands. A. Before B. Because
quiz.ans: A——说的是吃饭之前的顺序，是时间队。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 1 节「报先后」。

quiz.q: 「一……就……」用哪个连词？A. until B. as soon as
quiz.ans: B——as soon as 专管「一发生就跟上」。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 2 节。

items.name: when
items.gloss: 当……的时候
items.ex: Call me when you arrive.

items.name: before
items.gloss: 在……之前
items.ex: Wash your hands before you eat.

adult.t: 时间组词表与例句模式出自研究合集 1.4 时间组（EnglishClub / Cambridge / Khan 分类综合）；逗号规则同 NEW-CJ04 所引 EnglishClub 结构图与 Purdue OWL。since 的时间义也在本队（since she won），其介词/原因用法见 NEW-CJ12 与 NEW-CJ06。
新拟规律，尚未与规律目录对账（待对账）；内容依据下列研究来源，与目录冲突时以目录为准。

data.desc: because、since、as 都能说理由：because 声音最大、最直白——She was absent because she was ill.
data.formal: 研究合集原因组（综合 EnglishClub / Cambridge / Khan 分类表）：as, because, now that, since；其中 as / since 表原因时语气较弱、较正式。
data.kid: 想说理由就请原因队：because 是大喇叭，since 和 as 是轻声版。

beats.name: because 是主力
beats.text: 直接回答「为什么」，口语书面都常用，是孩子先要掌握的那一个。

beats.name: since / as 是轻声版
beats.text: 理由是大家都知道的、只是顺带一提时，用 since 或 as：语气较弱，也较正式（研究合集原因组原注）。

beats.name: 原因句也是挂车
beats.text: because、since 带的仍然是从属分句：放在句首，后面加逗号（Since the road was blocked, we took another route.）；放在句末，一般不加逗号。

examples.s: She was absent because she was ill.
examples.note: because：她缺席因为生病了（研究合集原例）

examples.s: Since the road was blocked, we took another route.
examples.note: since：路堵了，所以改道（研究合集原例，句首加逗号）

examples.s: I stayed home because it rained.
examples.note: because 句末版（与 GR-11 同一句的正面用法）

examples.s: As it was late, we went home.
examples.note: as：天晚了，轻声说理由

examples.s: He is happy because he has a new bike.
examples.note: because：有新车所以开心

examples.s: Because the bus was late, I was late for school.
examples.note: because 句首版：挂车在前，加逗号

errors.wrong: Because it rained.
errors.right: We stayed home because it rained.
errors.type: 句子残缺（fragment）
errors.diag: 原因句也是挂车，单独成句就残缺。回补 NEW-CJ04 机制第 1 节。

errors.wrong: Since the road was blocked. We took another route.
errors.right: Since the road was blocked, we took another route.
errors.type: 句号误切挂车
errors.diag: 句号把挂车单独切了出去；挂车在句首时用逗号接回主句。回补机制第 3 节。

quiz.q: 哪个词说理由最直白？A. because B. although
quiz.ans: A——because 是原因队的主力。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 1 节。

quiz.q: 把句子补完整：Since it snowed, ___.
quiz.ans: 参考答案：we made a snowman.（since 带出大家都知道的理由，主句说结果。）
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 2、3 节。

groups.title: 🧩 分组看看：原因队三兄弟

items.name: because
items.gloss: 声音最大，直接回答「为什么」
items.ex: She was absent because she was ill.

items.name: since
items.gloss: 理由大家都知道，顺带一提，较正式
items.ex: Since the road was blocked, we took another route.

items.name: as
items.gloss: 和 since 像，轻声说理由
items.ex: As it was late, we went home.

data.note: because 和 so 不能同上的规矩单独立条，见 GR-11（目录定版）。

adult.t: 原因组词表出自研究合集 1.4（EnglishClub / Cambridge / Khan 综合），as/since「较弱、较正式」为合集原注；now that 亦在原因组，小学阶段只认脸，不单列。since 的时间义见 NEW-CJ05，身兼数职的判别见 NEW-CJ12。
新拟规律，尚未与规律目录对账（待对账）；内容依据下列研究来源，与目录冲突时以目录为准。

data.short: 条件与让步队：if 开条件，although 让一步
data.desc: if 说「要是…」，although 说「尽管…」：Although it was cold, he didn't wear a jacket. ——注意：although 后面不能再跟一个 but。
data.formal: 研究合集条件组：as long as, even if, if, in case, only if, provided that, unless, whether or not；让步组：although, even though, though, whereas, while。Cambridge 语法栏："we only use one conjunction to connect words or phrases"，并给出错误示范 "Not: Because my alarm didn't go off, so I was late for work."
data.kid: if 是开关：条件到了，事情才发生。although 是让步：先让一步，后面的事照样发生。

beats.name: if = 要是
beats.text: if 领着条件：条件成立，后面的结果才来。If you study, you will pass.（要是你学习，你就会通过）

beats.name: unless = if…not
beats.text: unless 是「除非 / 要是不……就不……」：She won't go unless you invite her.（你不邀请她，她就不去）

beats.name: although = 尽管
beats.text: although 先让一步：情况明明不利，后面的事还是发生了。Although the task was difficult, everyone completed it.

beats.name: 双连词坑（和 GR-11 呼应）
beats.text: 汉语的「虽然…但是…」是成对的，搬进英语只能留一个：选 although 就扔掉 but，选 but 就扔掉 although。Cambridge 的错误示范就是这个道理（研究合集第 4 章）。

examples.s: If you study, you will pass.
examples.note: if：条件在前（研究合集原例）

examples.s: She won't go unless you invite her.
examples.note: unless：不邀请就不去（研究合集原例）

examples.s: Although the task was difficult, everyone completed it.
examples.note: although：任务难，大家还是完成了（研究合集原例）

examples.s: Although it was cold, he didn't wear a jacket.
examples.note: although 只用一个连接点（研究合集正例）

examples.s: If it rains, we will stay home.
examples.note: if：下雨就待在家

examples.s: Even though he was tired, he finished his homework.
examples.note: even though：让步加强版

errors.wrong: Although it was cold, but he didn't wear a jacket.
errors.right: Although it was cold, he didn't wear a jacket. / It was cold, but he didn't wear a jacket.
errors.type: 母语迁移-双连词（虽然…但是）
errors.diag: 研究合集第 4 章点名的中国学生专项错误：汉语成对关联词迁移。两个连接点留一个。回补机制第 4 节；因果版见 GR-11。

errors.wrong: Although the task was difficult, but everyone completed it.
errors.right: Although the task was difficult, everyone completed it.
errors.type: 母语迁移-双连词（虽然…但是）
errors.diag: 同一个坑：although 已经标好了让步关系，but 是多余的第二个连接点。回补机制第 4 节。

errors.wrong: If you study.
errors.right: If you study, you will pass.
errors.type: 句子残缺（fragment）
errors.diag: if 带的也是挂车，要挂上主句才完整。回补 NEW-CJ04 机制第 1 节。

quiz.q: 改错：Although I was tired, but I went to bed late.
quiz.ans: 删掉 but（或删掉 although、把 but 留下并改成两个分句：一座桥只留一个连接点）。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 4 节「双连词坑」。

quiz.q: unless 的意思最接近哪一个？A. if…not B. because
quiz.ans: A——unless ≈ if…not（要是不……就不……）。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 2 节。

groups.title: 🧩 分组看看：条件队

items.name: if
items.gloss: 要是……（条件成立，结果才来）
items.ex: If you study, you will pass.

items.name: unless
items.gloss: 除非……；要是不……就不……
items.ex: She won't go unless you invite her.

items.name: even if
items.gloss: 即使……也（认脸）
items.ex: Even if it rains, we will go.

groups.title: 🧩 分组看看：让步队

items.name: although
items.gloss: 尽管……（先让一步）
items.ex: Although the task was difficult, everyone completed it.

items.name: though
items.gloss: 和 although 同义，口语里更常见
items.ex: Though it was cold, he didn't wear a jacket.

items.name: even though
items.gloss: 尽管……（语气比 although 更强）
items.ex: Even though he was tired, he finished his homework.

data.note: 与 GR-11 互挂：GR-11 管 because…so，本条管 although…but，是同一个「双连词」家族的两个成员。

adult.t: 条件/让步分组与词表出自研究合集 1.4；双连词规则引 Cambridge 语法栏原话与错误示范（经教材转引核对，index），学理说明见合集第 4 章（UKEssays 转引 Leung & Holmer 关于中国 ESL 学习者的研究：汉语 因为…所以…、虽然…但是… 为成对关联词，学习者把成对习惯迁移进英语）。though 与 although 同义为分类表通例；even if 例句为呈现层新拟。
新拟规律，尚未与规律目录对账（待对账）；内容依据下列研究来源，与目录冲突时以目录为准。

canonical.title: 时间队：先做哪件，后做哪件
canonical.headline: 研究合集时间组（综合 EnglishClub / Cambridge / Khan 分类表）：after, as, as soon as, before, once, since, till, until, when, whenever, while；EnglishClub 常用表含 after, before, till, until, when, while。
canonical.kid_headline: 这队连词一开口，先把两件事的先后顺序报清楚。

established.note: 由候选 CJ05（时间队）+CJ06（原因队）+CJ07（条件/让步队）合并立条「从属连词功能分队」；三队的双连词禁忌部分与 GR-11 分工（禁忌归 GR-11，本条辖分队名单与用法）

立条来源（合并）：候选 NEW-CJ06

data.desc: 按工作分队：转折请 however，因果请 therefore，排顺序请 first、next、finally——先想清要表达哪种关系，再去对应的队里拿词。
data.formal: ThoughtCo："a conjunctive adverb is an adverb or adverbial phrase that indicates a relation in meaning between two sequential independent clauses (or main clauses)"；Cambridge 称此类词为 linking adjuncts。分类表综合 EnglishClub / QuillBot / ThoughtCo 三家（研究合集第 2 章）。
data.kid: 连接副词像一个工具箱，每组干一种活：加话、转弯、说结果、排顺序……先想好要干哪种活，再打开对应的格子。

beats.name: 先认活，再选词
beats.text: 选连接副词的第一步不是背词，是想清两句话是什么关系：是往上加（添加），还是拐弯（转折），还是前因后果（因果）——关系定了，词就定了。

beats.name: 小学先精学几个
beats.text: however（转折）、therefore（因果）、first / next / finally（顺序）、for example（举例）最常用，先精学；其余的在「分组看看」里认脸，阅读时能认出就行（研究合集第 5 章的分段建议）。

beats.name: 每组都有连词工友
beats.text: 连接副词和连词有功能对应：and ↔ moreover（添加）、but ↔ however（转折）、so ↔ therefore（结果）、yet ↔ nevertheless（让步转折）——活儿一样，词性和标点规矩不一样（研究合集第 3 章功能对应表）。

examples.s: She loves playing the piano; moreover, she is a great singer.
examples.note: 添加队 moreover（EnglishClub 原例）

examples.s: He studied hard for the test; however, he didn't pass.
examples.note: 转折队 however（EnglishClub 原例）

examples.s: She didn't study for the exam; therefore, she failed.
examples.note: 因果队 therefore（EnglishClub 原例）

examples.s: Gather the ingredients. Next, mix them together.
examples.note: 顺序队 next（QuillBot 原例）

examples.s: He is my best friend. In fact, he is like my brother.
examples.note: 强调队 in fact

examples.s: Some animals sleep all winter; for example, bears sleep for months.
examples.note: 举例队 for example

examples.s: Tom is good at drawing. Similarly, his sister is good at painting.
examples.note: 类比队 similarly

examples.s: In conclusion, reading is fun and good for us.
examples.note: 总结队 in conclusion

errors.wrong: I like reading, moreover, I like writing.
errors.right: I like reading; moreover, I like writing. / I like reading. Moreover, I like writing.
errors.type: 逗号粘连（连接副词版）
errors.diag: moreover 和 however 一样是连接副词：只用逗号粘不住。回补 NEW-CJ09 机制第 2、3 节。

errors.wrong: The movie was boring. However I stayed to the end.
errors.right: The movie was boring. However, I stayed to the end.
errors.type: 连接副词后漏逗号
errors.diag: 连接副词放在句首时，后面要加逗号（Purdue OWL：逗号用在 transitional element 之后）。回补机制第 1 节。

quiz.q: 要表「转折」，去哪组拿词？A. however B. therefore
quiz.ans: A——however 是转折队的队长。
quiz.hint: 回到分组看看的转折队。

quiz.q: 给做事排顺序，用哪一组？A. first, next, finally B. however, nevertheless
quiz.ans: A——顺序队专门排先后。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 2 节。

groups.title: 🧩 分组看看：八组功能队（每组先精学带 ★ 的，其余认脸）

items.name: 添加队 moreover ★
items.gloss: 认脸：furthermore, in addition, also, besides
items.ex: She loves playing the piano; moreover, she is a great singer.

items.name: 转折队 however ★
items.gloss: 认脸：nevertheless, instead, on the other hand
items.ex: He studied hard for the test; however, he didn't pass.

items.name: 因果队 therefore ★
items.gloss: 认脸：consequently, as a result, thus
items.ex: She didn't study for the exam; therefore, she failed.

items.name: 顺序队 first / next / finally ★
items.gloss: 认脸：then, meanwhile, eventually
items.ex: First, wash the apples. Next, cut them. Finally, eat them.

items.name: 强调队 in fact
items.gloss: 认脸：indeed, actually
items.ex: He is my best friend. In fact, he is like my brother.

items.name: 举例队 for example ★
items.gloss: 认脸：for instance, namely
items.ex: Some animals sleep all winter; for example, bears sleep for months.

items.name: 类比队 similarly
items.gloss: 认脸：likewise
items.ex: Tom is good at drawing. Similarly, his sister is good at painting.

items.name: 总结队 in conclusion
items.gloss: 认脸：overall, in summary, in short
items.ex: In conclusion, reading is fun and good for us.

adult.t: 八组分类综合 EnglishClub / QuillBot / ThoughtCo 三家分类表（三源重合度高，研究合集 2.2）；ThoughtCo 另有字母序总表备查。功能对应表见合集第 3 章。分段建议（合集 5.5）：连接副词对小学生只要求认识 however / therefore / first / next / finally 的篇章用法，不要求分号写作——本页例句中的分号句式供高年级与教师层。
新拟规律，尚未与规律目录对账（待对账）；内容依据下列研究来源，与目录冲突时以目录为准。

data.desc: however、therefore 能在自己的分句里搬家：句首、主谓之间、句末都可以住——It was raining; we, however, stayed home. 逗号跟着它走。
data.formal: ThoughtCo 引 Reid《The Prentice Hall Guide for College Writers》移动测试："Conjunctive adverbs can be moved; subordinating conjunctions (such as if and because) and coordinating conjunctions (but, or, yet, for, and, nor, so) cannot."；Cambridge：linking adjuncts "can come in any position which an adverb can occupy"。
data.kid: 连词是钉死的，连接副词是活的：它能在自己的分句里搬家，搬到哪里，逗号就跟到哪里。

beats.name: 移动测试
beats.text: 分不清一个词是连词还是连接副词？把它在分句里挪个位置试试：能挪的是连接副词，挪了就坏的是连词（ThoughtCo 引 Reid 的判别法）。

beats.name: 三个住址
beats.text: 句首：分号或句号之后，后面加逗号。主谓之间：前后各加一个逗号。句末：前面加逗号，后面是句号。（MIT Writing Guide 三位置规则）

beats.name: 连词不能搬
beats.text: but、because 们钉在原地：并列连词必须站在两个成分之间，从属连词必须站在自己分句的最前面——搬走，句子就坏了（Cambridge）。

examples.s: It was raining; however, we stayed home.
examples.note: 句首：however 住在分句开头

examples.s: It was raining; we, however, stayed home.
examples.note: 句中：however 住在主谓之间，前后逗号

examples.s: The test was hard; I passed it, however.
examples.note: 句末：however 住在分句末尾，前面逗号

examples.s: The sun came out; therefore, we went to the park.
examples.note: therefore 句首版

examples.s: She was tired. She, however, kept working.
examples.note: 句中版：however 被两个逗号夹住

examples.s: The lithium ion battery lasts longer than the NiCad battery; therefore, one lithium ion battery may suffice.
examples.note: MIT Writing Guide 演示原例（教师演示用）

errors.wrong: However it was raining, we stayed home.
errors.right: Although it was raining, we stayed home. / It was raining; however, we stayed home.
errors.type: 把 however 当从属连词领句
errors.diag: however 不是连词，不能像 although 那样领着一个分句往前走；它只能住在第二个分句里面。回补机制第 1、3 节。

errors.wrong: It was cold; therefore we stayed home.
errors.right: It was cold; therefore, we stayed home.
errors.type: 句首连接副词后漏逗号
errors.diag: 连接副词住在句首时，后面必须跟逗号（MIT 规则一）。回补机制第 2 节。

quiz.q: 哪个词能在分句里搬家？A. because B. however
quiz.ans: B——能搬家的是连接副词 however。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 1 节「移动测试」。

quiz.q: It was late; we, ___, went home.（填 however）——however 前后要不要加逗号？
quiz.ans: 前后都要加：we, however, went home.
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 2 节「三个住址」。

groups.title: 🧩 分组看看：therefore 的三个住址（MIT 演示原句）

items.name: 句首
items.gloss: 分号在前，它后面加逗号
items.ex: The lithium ion battery lasts longer than the NiCad battery; therefore, one lithium ion battery may suffice.

items.name: 主谓之间
items.gloss: 前后各加一个逗号，像插入语
items.ex: The lithium ion battery lasts longer than the NiCad battery; one lithium ion battery, therefore, may suffice.

items.name: 句末
items.gloss: 前面加逗号，后面是句号
items.ex: The lithium ion battery lasts longer than the NiCad battery; one lithium ion battery may suffice, therefore.

adult.t: 移动测试引 ThoughtCo 转引 Reid（verified live）；三位置标点对照为 MIT Writing Guide 规则（index，QuillBot / Lumen 交叉一致）；Cambridge 的 as a result 三位置演示同向。EnglishClub 补充：therefore / thus / consequently 表严格因果时多放句首，however / indeed / in fact 放句中最自由（index）。
新拟规律，尚未与规律目录对账（待对账）；内容依据下列研究来源，与目录冲突时以目录为准。

canonical.title: 连接副词八组功能队
canonical.headline: ThoughtCo："a conjunctive adverb is an adverb or adverbial phrase that indicates a relation in meaning between two sequential independent clauses (or main clauses)"；Cambridge 称此类词为 linking adjuncts。分类表综合 EnglishClub / QuillBot / ThoughtCo 三家（研究合集第 2 章）。
canonical.kid_headline: 连接副词像一个工具箱，每组干一种活：加话、转弯、说结果、排顺序……先想好要干哪种活，再打开对应的格子。

established.note: 由候选 CJ10+CJ11 合并立条「连接副词」；对账结论：连接副词在图鉴全部模型 0 命中（无定义、无词表、无判别），整组真空白立条

data.short: 身兼数职的词：看后面跟什么
data.desc: before、after、since、until 有好几副面孔：后跟名词是介词，后跟句子是连词，后面什么都不跟是副词——I had never been there before.
data.formal: Khan Academy 提醒："some of these you might recognize as being adverbs or prepositions in other contexts… You may notice some of them like, after and before, are prepositions."；判别标准（研究合集 1.6）：看它后面跟什么——跟名词/代词是介词，跟完整分句是从属连词，后面什么都不跟、单独修饰动词是副词。
data.kid: 同一个词，换个位置就换一身衣服。想知道它今天当什么，别看它长什么样，看它后面跟着什么。

beats.name: 判别法：看后面
beats.text: 三步认人：后面跟名词或代词 → 介词；后面跟一整个分句（主语 + 动词）→ 从属连词；后面什么都不跟 → 副词。

beats.name: before 的三副面孔
beats.text: before the lesson（介词）/ before I come back（连词）/ had never been there before（副词）——同一个 before，三种身份，全看后面。

beats.name: since 一词两义
beats.text: since 当连词时有两副面孔：表时间「自从」（since she won）和表原因「既然」（since the road was blocked）；当介词时只表时间（since 2020）。until / till 也是介词、连词两栖。

examples.s: We shall discuss it before the lesson.
examples.note: before 介词脸：后面跟名词 the lesson（研究合集原例）

examples.s: Don't go away before I come back.
examples.note: before 连词脸：后面跟分句 I come back（研究合集原例）

examples.s: I had never been there before.
examples.note: before 副词脸：后面什么都不跟（研究合集原例）

examples.s: We play games after school.
examples.note: after 介词脸：after school

examples.s: We went home after the meeting ended.
examples.note: after 连词脸：后面跟分句

examples.s: I haven't seen him since 2020.
examples.note: since 介词脸：后面跟年份（时间）

examples.s: We waited until Friday.
examples.note: until 介词脸：后面跟名词 Friday

examples.s: We waited until you called.
examples.note: until 连词脸：后面跟分句 you called

errors.wrong: 「I had never been there before.」里的 before 是连词。
errors.right: 是副词：它后面什么都不跟，单独修饰 been there。
errors.type: 身份误判
errors.diag: 判别病例：认身份不看长相，看后面跟什么。回补机制第 1 节。

errors.wrong: 「We shall discuss it before the lesson.」里的 before 是连词。
errors.right: 是介词：它后面跟的是名词 the lesson，不是一个分句。
errors.type: 身份误判
errors.diag: 判别病例：后面跟名词 → 介词脸。回补机制第 1、2 节。

quiz.q: 「Call me before you leave.」里的 before 是什么？A. 介词 B. 连词
quiz.ans: B——它后面跟的是分句 you leave。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 1 节「判别法：看后面」。

quiz.q: 「I have seen this film before.」里的 before 是什么？
quiz.ans: 副词——它后面什么都不跟。
quiz.hint: 回到机制第 2 节。

groups.title: 🧩 分组看看：before 的三副面孔

items.name: 介词脸
items.gloss: 后面跟名词 / 代词
items.ex: We shall discuss it before the lesson.

items.name: 连词脸
items.gloss: 后面跟完整分句（主语 + 动词）
items.ex: Don't go away before I come back.

items.name: 副词脸
items.gloss: 后面什么都不跟
items.ex: I had never been there before.

groups.title: 🧩 分组看看：其他多面手

items.name: after
items.gloss: after school 是介词脸；after the meeting ended 是连词脸
items.ex: We play games after school.

items.name: since
items.gloss: since 2020 介词脸（时间）；since she won 连词脸（时间）；since the road was blocked 连词脸（原因）
items.ex: Since the road was blocked, we took another route.

items.name: until
items.gloss: until Friday 介词脸；until you call 连词脸
items.ex: We waited until you called.

data.note: so 也是多面手：并列连词（结果）、so that 的省略式、副词（so tired）——研究合集指出这是中国学习者最困惑的词之一；though 也有连词脸与句末副词脸（I like it, though.）。

adult.t: 判别法与 before 三例引研究合集 1.6（Khan Academy 讲解转录，index；例句为合集原文）；since 三用法、until/till 两栖同出该节。so 的三重身份与 though 的双身份见合集 1.6 及第 4 章注（UKEssays 转引研究指 so 的多重身份是中国学习者困惑点）。
